narrative.northStar: The Stand Alone Complex instrument panel
narrative.overview: A minimal instrument panel for one person's work in the Stand Alone Complex register: cyan means interaction, amber means recorded data, and the section being read acquires a bracket reticle. Light is institutional daylight, dark is the green-cast night city. Nothing animates without the reader. The world lives in palette, geometry, and state - never in invented lore or borrowed art.
keyCharacteristics: Two-signal palette: cyan for interaction, amber for recorded data, no alarm red
Ruled registers with a bracket reticle that follows the reader
No ambient motion: every movement answers scroll, hover, focus, press, or theme choice
Condensed display, humanist body, monospace data
Unnumbered content, always-visible navigation, real destinations

researchInterpretation.summary: The endpoint inspection is an original interpretation of localized information density and bounded acquisition displays. It does not reproduce franchise art, characters, symbols, or text.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan means you can act or you are here; amber means this is recorded data. Neither takes the other's job.

rules.name: The No-Alarm Rule
rules.body: No red is defined because the page has no alert state; add the token when a surface gains one.

rules.name: The Reticle Rule
rules.body: Only the register being read is bracketed. The hero takes the acquisition scan; everything else is still.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks anything measured, addressed, or classified; prose is never set in it.

dos: Do keep every control at a 44px minimum target and every action on cyan.
Do keep recorded data on amber: destinations, categories, days, genres.
Do measure contrast in both themes before changing a token.
donts: Don't reproduce franchise art, marks, on-screen text, or character references.
Don't invent case numbers, timestamps, or other fictional data.
Don't add cards, radii, shadows, or a second framing device.
